full_prompt_en: A saturated paper-collage-style illustration fills the frame with an abundant garden of pink and violet blossoms. Large layered flowers overlap from edge to edge, including a pale blush bloom with a dark golden center near the upper right, a deep magenta flower above it, and a warm orange-red rose-like form lower left. Smaller blue clusters, yellow-centered blossoms, and scattered green leaves thread through the gaps. There is almost no empty background; glimpses of muted mauve and teal appear between stems and petals. Each flower is assembled from distinct curved and angular color facets rather than smooth shaded gradients. Pink petals shift through pale rose, coral, fuchsia, and cool lavender patches, their cut-like boundaries visible and occasionally textured by fine parallel strokes. Teal and turquoise leaves and small blue flowers punctuate the warm field, while deep plum and navy pockets provide enough darkness for the colors to glow. A few mustard-yellow and scarlet marks add bright sparks at the flower centers. Illumination is even and decorative, with contrast built from color adjacency rather than realistic cast shadow. The large blooms establish a loose diagonal from lower left toward upper right, but many small stems and colored fragments move the eye around the entire square. The surface looks tactile, as though painted paper pieces have been layered, rubbed, and lightly scratched. The composition is exuberant and dense without a single dominant empty focal space, offering a continuous rhythm of color, curved edges, and overlapping depth.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅饱和的纸拼贴风插画让繁盛的粉紫花园填满画框。大朵层叠花从边到边互相遮掩，包括右上附近带深金色花心的浅粉花、其上深洋红花以及左下暖橙红的玫瑰状花。较小蓝色花簇、黄心花和零散绿叶穿过缝隙。背景几乎没有空处；茎叶与花瓣之间偶尔露出低调淡紫和青绿。每朵花由独立弯曲和角形色面拼成，而不是平滑明暗渐层。粉色花瓣在浅玫瑰、珊瑚、亮紫红与冷薰衣草色片之间转移，切纸般边界可见，并偶尔带细密平行纹。青绿和湖蓝叶片及蓝小花点破暖色场，深李紫与海军蓝口袋提供足够黑度让颜色发亮。少量芥末黄和猩红笔迹在花心处闪烁。照明均匀而装饰性，反差由相邻颜色建立，而非写实投影。大花朵从左下朝右上组成松斜线，许多细茎和色碎片则使目光遍游整个方幅。表面可触，像涂色纸片被层层叠起、擦磨并轻微抓出痕迹。构图奔放且密集，没有一处占主导的空焦点，提供连续色彩、弯曲边缘与重叠深度的节奏。
style_prompt_en: Saturated paper-collage-style illustration layers curved and angular color facets across nearly the entire frame. Pale blush, coral, fuchsia, lavender, and deep magenta form broad warm clusters, countered by turquoise, teal, blue, olive, and small mustard-yellow sparks. Boundaries resemble cut and overlapped painted paper, with occasional fine parallel texture, rubbed areas, and shallow scratches visible inside the shapes. Dark plum and navy pockets sit between bright layers, supplying depth without realistic cast shadows. Light is even and decorative; the energy comes from adjacent hue contrast and changing patch size. Large rounded forms create a loose diagonal, while smaller fragments fill gaps and lead the eye around the whole surface. The composition has very little untouched background, yet the varied scale of its marks maintains readability. Edges alternate smooth curved cuts and quick angular breaks. The resulting image is tactile, exuberant, and richly rhythmic, with flat color and overlapping planes doing the work of volume.
style_prompt_zh: 饱和的纸拼贴风插画把弯曲与角形色面层层铺满几乎整个画框。浅粉、珊瑚、亮紫红、薰衣草与深洋红组成宽阔暖色簇，由湖蓝、青绿、蓝、橄榄和小芥末黄火花相抵。边界像裁切叠压的彩绘纸片，形状内部偶有细平行纹、擦磨区域和浅抓痕。深李紫与海军蓝口袋坐在亮层之间，提供深度而不依赖写实投影。光均匀且装饰性；能量来自相邻色相对比和色片尺寸变化。大圆形建立松散斜线，小碎片填缝并带着目光绕遍全幅。构图几乎没有未触背景，但笔迹尺度多变，仍维持可读性。边缘在平滑弯切和迅捷角形断口间变化。结果可触、奔放、节奏浓郁，以平面颜色与叠压层承担体积工作。
theme_en: An abundant garden of layered pink and violet blossoms
theme_zh: 层叠粉紫花朵组成的繁盛花园
name: Paige Evans
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
